title: WAKE UP AND FIGHT 45 MINUTES EARLY MORNING PRAYER TO SET YOUR DAY ON FIRE FOR GOD
text: Wake up, not from physical sleep. You are already awake. Wake up from the passive version of yourself that was about to walk into today. The same way it walked into yesterday. The version that opens its eyes and immediately reaches for the phone instead of reaching for the throne. The version that begins the day reacting to everyone else's agenda instead of setting its own. The version that asks, "I wonder what today will bring?" >> [music] >> Instead of declaring, "I know what today will bring because I just came from the presence of God." Wake up from that version and fight, not from anger, not from frustration, not from the desperation of someone who has been losing. >> [music] >> Fight from the position of someone who has already won. Colossians 2:15, Jesus spoiled principalities and powers, made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in the cross. The war was won at Calvary. What you are doing in these 45 minutes is not winning the war. You are enforcing a victory that was already [music] won. There is a difference between a soldier fighting to win and a soldier enforcing a peace treaty. The soldier fighting to win >> [music] >> is not sure of the outcome. The soldier enforcing the treaty knows the verdict. [music] They are not trying, they are executing. That is you in these 45 minutes. You are not trying to overcome the enemy. He's already overcome. You are enforcing the terms of the victory. You are making sure the enemy does not operate in territory that was stripped from him at the cross. You are making sure the day belongs to God, not by accident, not by default, by the aggressive early morning prayer of a believer who woke up and chose to fight. Matthew chapter 11:12, "And from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffered violence and the violent take it by force. The violent take it by force. Not the polite, not the passive, not the ones who ask nicely and hope the kingdom cooperates. The violent biastes the Greek word translated violent. It means one who presses forward forcefully. One who does not accept the default. One who refuses to let the day be shaped by everything except their own prayer. One who wakes up and fights. That is the person this 45 minutes is for. Not for the believer who occasionally prays when they feel spiritual. For the one who wakes up every morning and chooses to be violent. Violent in prayer, violent in faith, violent in the occupation of the day's territory. 45 minutes. Set this day on fire for God. Not lukewarm, not warm, on fire. Revelation 3:16. Because thou art lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, >> [music] >> I will spew thee out of my mouth. God does not do lukewarm and the violent believer does not do lukewarm. Every day on fire. This day on fire. Before the 45 minutes send this word. Send it to someone who has been sleepwalking through their days. Not physically, spiritually. [music] Moving through hours that could be on fire but are instead merely warm. Functioning but not burning. Present but not ablaze. Send them this word. Wake them up because the fire spreads and one person who wakes up and fights can set an entire network on fire. Now before the 45 minutes of fire, I want to give you the revelation of what it means to set your day on fire for God >> [music] >> because most believers have been taught a passive morning spirituality. [music] They have been taught to be quiet in the morning, to be still, to reflect, to journal gently, and there is a place for all of that. But, that is not this. This is the Elijah morning. 1 Kings chapter 18, 450 prophets of Baal on one side, one man on the other. And Elijah does not open with a gentle, reflective journal entry. He opens with a challenge. Verse 20:1, "How long halt ye between two opinions? If the Lord be God, follow him. But, if Baal, then follow him." He confronted the compromise. He named the division. He forced [music] a decision. And then he called down fire. Verse 38, "Then the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked [music] up the water that was in the trench." The fire of the Lord fell. It consumed the sacrifice. >> [music] >> Expected. [singing] It consumed the wood. Expected. But, then the stones, the dust, [music] and the water. They had poured water on the altar to make the miracle harder, [music] to make it more impossible, to make it undeniable when God answered. And the fire of God did not merely survive the water. It consumed the water. Hear me. This is a revelation. Whatever the enemy has poured on your altar to make your breakthrough harder, the obstacles, the delays, the opposition, [music] the discouragement, the water he poured to make the fire seem impossible, the fire of God does not merely survive those things. It consumes them and licks them up. [music] And the miracle becomes more undeniable because of the water, not in spite of it. The harder the enemy made it, the louder the testimony becomes when the fire falls. And the fire falls when the Elijah believer wakes up and fights. When the one man stands against the 450 [music] and says, "God will answer by fire." The second revelation is from the New Testament. Luke chapter 24:49. Jesus speaking to the disciples just before the ascension. And behold, "I send the promise of my father upon you. But tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem until ye be endued with power from on high." Endued with power from on high. The Greek word for endued is enduo, to clothe, to put on, to be invested with, like putting on a garment. The power of the Holy Ghost is not just in you, it is on you. A covering, a mantle, >> [music] >> a fire garment worn over the natural person. And Acts 1:8, "Ye shall receive power after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you." Power dunamis. Explosive force, inherent ability, the same word used for dynamite. Not the gentle warmth of a candle, the explosive force of God on you, in you, through you. The 45-minute [music] early morning prayer is the daily putting on of the fire garment. It is the daily enduing. Elijah prayed and the fire fell. You pray at 6:00 a.m. and the fire falls. Not on a stone altar, on you. And you carry the fire into your day, into every room, every conversation, every closed door. And the water the enemy poured, the obstacles, the delays, the opposition gets consumed. Now, 45 minutes, nine segments, set your day on fire. >> [music] >> Segment one, wake up your spirit. Before the body is fully awake, the spirit must be awakened. The spirit that spent the night in relative inactivity must be roused to full alert before the day can be engaged. Father, I wake up my spirit. Ephesians 5:14, "Awake thou that sleepest and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light. I am awake. I arise. Let Christ give me light right now. Not the artificial light of a phone screen, the light of his presence illuminating my spirit at the start of this day. I stir up the gift that is in me. 2 Timothy 1:6, "The gift does not operate at full capacity when it is unstirred." [music] Like a fire that has been banked overnight, the coals are alive, but they need [music] to be stirred to flame. I stir the gift. I stir the anointing. I stir the faith. I stir the boldness. I stir the discernment. Every dormant capacity in my spirit stirred, active, alert, [music] operating at full flame. Psalm 57:7-8, "I wake up my glory. Awake, psaltery and harp. The gifts are stirred. The glory is active. The day begins with awakened spirit. Segment two, apply the blood and consecrate. Every day >> [music] >> must begin with the blood. Not as formality, as the most strategic act of the morning. The blood of Jesus is the first line of defense. >> [music] >> Before the enemy can reach the day, he must pass through the blood. Nehemiah 8:10, this day is holy unto our Lord. Holy, set apart, separated, [music] belonging specifically to God. This day does not belong to the enemy. This day does not belong to random chance. This day is holy. It belongs to God from the first hour to the last. And because it is holy, the common cannot operate in it. The enemy cannot operate freely in a consecrated day. Darkness cannot hold ground in a day that has been made holy. Segment three, warfare, clear the atmosphere. The atmosphere is the spiritual environment of the day. And every morning, the atmosphere must be cleared. The enemy walks through the atmosphere. >> [music] >> He creates a spiritual climate of heaviness, dread, confusion, anxiety. And the believer who does not pray walks straight into that climate >> [music] >> and wonders why the day feels oppressive from the first hour. But the believer who fights in the early morning prayer clears the atmosphere before stepping into it. In the name of Jesus, I address every dark spirit operating in the atmosphere of this day. Spirit of heaviness, Isaiah 61-3 calls it by name. The garment of praise is given for the spirit of heaviness. Spirit of heaviness, I put on the garment of praise over you. You are displaced. The heaviness is consumed. The atmosphere of this day is praise, not heaviness. The spirit of confusion, 1 Corinthians 14:33, God is not the author of confusion. If God is not the author, it has an enemy author. Spirit of confusion assembled for my decisions today, bound. The mind of Christ, 1 Corinthians 2:16, governs this day's thinking. Spirit of destruction, the enemy's primary strategy against the called person. Not a frontal assault on the assignment. A thousand small diversions that collectively consume the day. Every destruction spirit assigned to this day, bound. Hebrews 12:1, laying aside every weight that doth so easily beset. [music] The weights are laid aside before the race begins. Spirit of fear, time for today, 2 Timothy 1:7, God has not given it. Whatever was not given by God does not belong here. Expelled [music] out of the atmosphere, out of the mind, out of the decisions of today. The atmosphere is cleared. Clean, consecrated, fire-ready air for the day. Segment four, warfare, bind the strongman of the day. Matthew 12:29, bind the strongman first. The first work, before spoiling the goods, bind the strongman. Every day has a strongman. The principality specifically assigned to undermine this day, not yesterday's strong men, today's. The one assigned to disrupt the specific appointments of this specific day, I bind [music] the strong man of this day. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, bound. The strong man of financial obstruction for today, bound. Every spirit positioned to block, delay, or steal financial provision today, bound before the first transaction of the day. The strong man of relational sabotage for today, bound. Every spirit positioned to manufacture offense, misunderstanding, division today, bound before the first conversation of the day. The strong man of physical attack for today, bound. Every assignment against the body, sickness, accident, exhaustion, bound before the body leaves the house. The strong man of destiny disruption for today, bound. Every spirit positioned to redirect, delay, or derail the calling's [music] advancement today, bound before the day's first step toward the assignment. Strong men are bound. The goods are ready to be spoiled. The day [music] is ready to yield its God-prepared contents. Segment five, loose the fire of God. Now the fire is released. Not as a defense mechanism, as the primary force of the day. Father, let your fire fall on this day. The same fire [music] that fell on the altar of Elijah, 1 Kings 18:38, that consumed the sacrifice, the wood, the stones, [music] the dust, the water, let that fire fall on this day, on this [music] life, on this calling. Fire of purification, fall on my words today. Isaiah 6:6, the live coal [music] from the altar touching the lips. Let every word spoken from my lips today be fire touched, pure, accurate, anointed, waiting [music] the spirit, the kind of words that shift atmospheres when they are spoken, the kind of words that people carry with them for years. Fire empowered gift >> [music] >> operating beyond the capacity of the natural. Fire of boldness fall on my voice today. Acts 4:31, they were all filled with the Holy Ghost >> [music] >> and they spake [singing] the word of God with boldness. The same feeling, the same boldness. Today, the voice that was timid yesterday, bold today. The word that was withheld yesterday, spoken today. The step that was postponed yesterday, taken today. Fire of favor fall on my path today. Psalm 5:12, thou Lord will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass him as with a shield. A shield of favor around the perimeter of every step today. Favor that opens the room before I knock. Favor that changes the answer before I ask. Favor that makes my name remembered in rooms I have never entered. The fire is loosed. The days are blessed. Segment six, call forth the divine appointments. Before the day can present its default appointments, I call forth the divine ones. Romans 4:17, calling those things which be not as though they were. I call forth the person God has prepared for me to encounter today. The connection that carries a key, the introduction that opens a door, the stranger who speaks the word I have been waiting to hear, come forth, enter my day, make the connection. I call forth the word in season for today. Isaiah 50:2-4, the specific word God has prepared for the specific person I will meet today. Be in my mouth, be ready, be accurate, and the weary person I encounter today, I will know what to say to them. I call forth the open door for today. Revelation 3:2-8, the door God has set open no man can shut it. >> [music] >> I call it forth into today's hours, the opportunity prepared, the access granted, the room made available, come forth into today. I will recognize you when you arrive. I call for the protection of God on every road today. Psalm 91:2-11, he shall give his angels charge over thee. Angels assigned to every journey today, before me on every road, around me in every room, the protection that is already prepared, manifest today. I call forth the testimony of today, not at the end of the month, at the end of this day. One story, one moment, one undeniable evidence of God at work. Come [music] forth.
